title: Reset failure quarantines the complete affected bundle
blocker: The standalone lease/FSM component retains a whole-bundle claim for a simulated reset-failure label, but no production reset executor revalidates the authoritative affected set, executes a real reset, proves clean state, and integrates that evidence with the Static transaction. Component results cannot close physical reset safety.
assertions: the reset contract and affected set are re-read after ownership is acquired and before reset
a reset error or unverifiable post-reset state never transitions any affected member to FREE
all functional, reset and hidden-dependency members remain under one quarantined claim
leaving quarantine requires an explicit audited recovery and qualification workflow
